basic_info.description: 1 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $104,900, 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, Tuesday, April 29, 2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on May 22, 2025 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity. Open Houses: Thursday May 1st 5PM -7PM, Saturday, May 3rd 10 AM - 12 PM, Saturday, May 17th 10 AM-12 PM. Great location near the Panhandle; the unit includes an in-unit washer/dryer and parking.
